sampling_sql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT file_row_number AS source_row_number, * EXCLUDE(file_row_number)
    FROM read_parquet(?, file_row_number=true)
    WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
AND tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime
AND date_diff('minute', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime) <= 720
AND trip_distance > 0 AND trip_distance <= 100
AND fare_amount > 0 AND fare_amount <= 500
    ORDER BY md5(CAST(file_row_number AS VARCHAR)), file_row_number
    LIMIT 50000
) ORDER BY source_row_number
